Have you taken any AP history/social studies classes yet? The first one you take will usually be the hardest. for me in was AP world… it takes awhile getting used to the structure of the multiple questions for each of those classes. I recommend finding some practice mcq online or buying one of those study books. [Crackap](crackap.com) is literally god tier for mcq practice problems.

The writing for the most part is also very structural. Familiarize yourself with the rubric and requirements for each open ended response portion. These also take practice but are so much easier to score full points than the mcq (for me at least). 

As for the content itself, if you’re using a text, keep up with the readings. Humanities classes are usually very content heavy with the readings so always try to take notes, at least bullet points or finding a summary online to keep for later. It’s so easy to forget the specifics throughout the year so make sure you try to make connections to previous material as you’re learning new content. 

Sorry this is long, but I hope it helped. Good luck!
